Mod.name: Mahoraga: Adapt to Anything
Mod.description: Mahoraga, the Eight-Handled Wheel, waits in a temple arena carved into the great wall at the far east of the world (cross the desert eastwards). Every parallel world has its own, tougher Mahoraga. He adapts to anything, even drowning: take enough of one kind of damage and his wheel turns and he becomes immune to it. Every adaptation heals him to full, raises his max health by 25% and makes his attacks hit 20% harder. Fire takes longer to adapt to. His Sword of Extermination slashes cut through everything. The wheel teaches him new techniques: Giant Slash (after melee), Giant Napalm (after fire), Giant Nuke (after explosions), Electrocute Giant Punch (after electricity) and Holy Shower (after holy). Defeat him for the exclusive perk Adapt to Anything: each kind of harm you keep taking, drowning included, hurts you 50% less, up to 3 times per type. Fan-made, inspired by Jujutsu Kaisen by Gege Akutami.
